description: Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish with our own on-device model (EG-1), Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini key. No account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
